message.body:
Dear Farid Shaikh,

6 invoices are currently outstanding with us:

Invoice INV-2026-0066 — ₹7,16,000 (3920 rolls pallet wrap), due 2026-05-19,
97 days past that date.

With no written agreement in place, payment fell due within 15 days of acceptance, on 2026-05-19 (Section 15, MSMED Act 2006).

Interest has accrued from 2026-05-20 as compound interest with monthly rests at 16.50% per annum, being three times the RBI Bank Rate of 5.50% (Section 16, MSMED Act 2006). Interest to date: ₹31,310.53.

At the current rate this outstanding is adding about ₹341.89 each day; a further 7 days would add about ₹2,393.23.

Unpaid dues to a micro or small enterprise, together with the interest on them, are required to be disclosed in the annual statement of accounts (Section 22, MSMED Act 2006).

Interest paid under the MSMED Act is not allowed as a deduction when computing income (Section 23, MSMED Act 2006).
